sed -n 26,60p include/linux/fdtable.h; echo ----; sed -n 45,75p fs/mount.h; echo ----; sed -n 473,490p include/linux/fs.h; echo ----; sed -n 1838,1870p fs/namei.c; echo ----; sed -n 1916,1990p fs/inode.c | grep -n "i_nlink\|drop_inode\|evict\|atomic\|i_count" ; grep -n "f_ref\|f_count" include/linux/fs.h | head -5; grep -n "i_count" include/linux/fs.h | head -3

sed -n 1888,1925p fs/namei.c | grep -n "i_op->lookup\|d_alloc_parallel"; grep -n "__follow_mount_rcu\|^static bool __follow_mount_rcu\|^static int __traverse_mounts\|^struct mount \*__lookup_mnt" fs/namei.c fs/namespace.c | head; grep -n "ramfs_get_inode\|ramfs_fs_type\|ramfs_dir_inode_operations = \|ramfs_mknod\|simple_lookup\|ramfs_get_tree\|ramfs_fill_super" fs/ramfs/inode.c | head -20; grep -n "\.read_iter\|\.write_iter\|\.mmap" fs/ramfs/file-mmu.c; grep -n "^struct dentry \*simple_lookup" fs/libfs.c; sed -n 1260,1300p include/linux/fs.h | grep -n "f_pos\|f_inode\|f_op\|f_path\|f_mapping"
